1	extends SceneTree
2	## Step 2 pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §5, §10): what the archer does NOW, before any clip exists.
3	## Drives the real main scene only through keyboard events (Input.parse_input_event); never calls an
4	## archer or scarecrow method that changes state, never assigns to their variables. It only spawns
5	## scarecrows with Game.spawn_scarecrow() and reads state.
6	##   ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
7	##
8	## Frame model. --fixed-fps 60 and 60 physics ticks/s: one main-loop iteration = one physics tick.
9	## The script resumes on SceneTree.physics_frame, which is emitted BEFORE the nodes' physics step.
10	## So at each resume the world shows the result of the previous tick, and whatever the script does
11	## there (keys, spawns) takes effect in the next tick. A scenario's frame f counts game ticks
12	## completed since the scenario's setup (f = 0 is the setup itself). An event emitted during a
13	## tick (fired, died) is stamped with that tick's f and shows up in the log line of the same f.
14	## Every log line begins with Engine.get_process_frames() at the moment it is printed. Measured: an
15	## event emitted during the tick reports a process frame one lower (line "4 | a f=1" carries
16	## "fired ... pf 3"), so line P shows the state left by the physics tick of process frame P - 1.
17	##
18	## TIMING = numbers the brief changes on purpose (§5); re-pinned in Step 6.
19	## INVARIANT = must survive the change.
20	
21	const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
22	const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0
23	const FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS := 36            # Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL (0.6 s) at 60 ticks/s
24	
25	# ---- scenario design (chosen, not measured) ----------------------------------------------------
26	const C_HOLD_D_TICKS := 40                 # (c) D held for ticks 1..40, then A for ticks 41..80
27	const C_HOLD_A_TICKS := 40
28	const D_PAUSE_AT_F := 15                   # (d) P pressed after tick 15 ...
29	const D_PAUSE_TICKS := 30                  # ... and again 30 ticks later
30	const E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS := 30              # (e) ticks watched after the scarecrow reaches the wall
31	const F_FROZEN_TICKS := 30                 # (f) ticks watched after the loss before R
32	
33	# ---- TIMING: measured on baseline 2026-11-21 ----------------------------------------------------
34	const A_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) spawn (in the cone, cooldown 0) at f 0 -> first fired
35	const A_SHOT_GAPS := [36, 36, 36]          # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) shots at f 1, 37, 73, 109
36	const A_DEATH_F := 118                     # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) the 4th arrow kills it
37	const B_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
38	const B_SHOT_GAPS := [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36]   # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 4 on B_near, 4 on B_far
39	const C_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
40	const C_EXIT_F := 26                       # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame the target is outside the cone
41	const C_CD_ZERO_F := 37                    # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame the cooldown is 0 while it is outside
42	const C_REENTRY_F := 62                    # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame it is back inside the cone
43	const C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY := 0            # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: fired on the re-entry frame itself
44	const D_SHOT1_F := 1                       # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
45	const D_SHOT2_F := 67                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 1 + 36 + 30 paused frames
46	const D_PAUSE_SHIFT := 30                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (shot2 - shot1) - unpaused cadence
47	const E_WALL_F := 174                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 130 px at 0.75 px/tick, rounded up
48	const F_LOSS_F := 104                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: frame the run is LOST
49	const F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY := 1            # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: new run, spawn at f_s -> fired at f_s + 1
50	
51	var game: Game
52	var timing: Array[String] = []
53	var invariant: Array[String] = []
54	var passed := 0
55	var failed := 0
56	
57	var scen := ""
58	var f := 0                 # ticks completed since the scenario's setup
59	var gt := 0                # ticks completed since the test started
60	var run_id := 0            # incremented by each restart
61	var act := 0               # ticks the archer processed (not paused, World enabled) in this run
62	var next_active := true    # will the archer process the coming tick?
63	var prev_cd := 0.0
64	var pending: Array[Dictionary] = []   # fired events since the last log line
65	var shots: Array[Dictionary] = []     # every fired event
66	var arrows_added := 0                 # arrows that entered World/Arrows since the last log line
67	var tracked: Array[int] = []          # scarecrow instance ids
68	var labels := {}                      # id -> label
69	var deaths := {}                      # label -> {scen, f}
70	var wall_prev := {}                   # id -> [at_wall, y] at the previous log line
71	var transitions: Array[Dictionary] = []
72	var last_key := -1
73	var last_key_gt := -1
74	var dispatching_key := false
75	
76	# invariant counters, whole run
77	var inv_inactive_shots := 0
78	var inv_inactive_cd_changes := 0
79	var inv_inactive_detail := ""
80	var inv_arrow_mismatch := 0
81	var inv_arrow_detail := ""
82	var inv_wall_moves := 0
83	var inv_wall_detail := ""
84	
85	
86	func _initialize() -> void:
87		_run.call_deferred()
88	
89	
90	func _run() -> void:
91		game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
92		game.spawning_enabled = false
93		root.add_child(game)
94		game.archer.fired.connect(_on_fired)
95		game.arrows.child_entered_tree.connect(func(_n: Node) -> void: arrows_added += 1)
96		game.state_changed.connect(_on_state_changed)
97		await process_frame
98		scen = "boot"
99		for i in 3:
100			await _step()
101	
102		await _scen_a()
103		await _scen_b()
104		await _scen_c()
105		await _scen_d()
106		await _scen_e()
107		await _scen_f()
108		_global_invariants()
109	
110		print("== TIMING (changed on purpose by brief §5; re-pinned in Step 6) ==")
111		for line in timing:
112			print(line)
113		print("== INVARIANT (must survive the change) ==")
114		for line in invariant:
115			print(line)
116		print("RESULT test_pins_a7: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
117		quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)
118	
119	
120	# ---- checks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
121	
122	func _record(group: Array[String], name: String, ok: bool, detail: String) -> void:
123		if ok:
124			passed += 1
125			group.append("PASS %s" % name)
126		else:
127			failed += 1
128			group.append("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])
129	
130	
131	func _timing(name: String, measured: Variant, pinned: Variant) -> void:
132		_record(timing, "%s = %s" % [name, str(pinned)], measured == pinned, "measured %s" % str(measured))
133	
134	
135	func _inv(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
136		_record(invariant, name, ok, detail)
137	
138	
139	# ---- input --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
140	
141	func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
142		if pressed:
143			last_key = code
144			last_key_gt = gt
145		var ev := InputEventKey.new()
146		ev.keycode = code
147		ev.physical_keycode = code
148		ev.pressed = pressed
149		dispatching_key = true
150		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
151		Input.flush_buffered_events()
152		dispatching_key = false
153	
154	
155	func _tap(code: Key) -> void:
156		_key(code, true)
157		_key(code, false)
158	
159	
160	# ---- reading the world --------------------------------------------------------------------------
161	
162	func _in_cone(s: Scarecrow) -> bool:
163		var to := s.global_position - game.archer.global_position
164		return absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) <= deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)
165	
166	
167	func _live(id: int) -> Scarecrow:
168		var s := instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow
169		if s == null or not s.is_inside_tree() or s.is_queued_for_deletion() or s.is_dead():
170			return null
171		return s
172	
173	
174	func _nearest_in_cone() -> Scarecrow:
175		var best: Scarecrow = null
176		var best_d := INF
177		for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
178			var s := n as Scarecrow
179			if s == null or s.is_dead() or not _in_cone(s):
180				continue
181			var d := (s.global_position - game.archer.global_position).length()
182			if d < best_d:
183				best_d = d
184				best = s
185		return best
186	
187	
188	func _aimed_at(arrow: Arrow) -> Scarecrow:
189		var best: Scarecrow = null
190		var best_a := INF
191		for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
192			var s := n as Scarecrow
193			if s == null or s.is_dead():
194				continue
195			var a := absf(arrow.velocity.angle_to(s.global_position - arrow.position))
196			if a < best_a:
197				best_a = a
198				best = s
199		return best if best_a < 1e-3 else null
200	
201	
202	func _label(s: Scarecrow) -> String:
203		return "none" if s == null else str(labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"))
204	
205	
206	func _live_arrows() -> int:
207		var n := 0
208		for c in game.arrows.get_children():
209			if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
210				n += 1
211		return n
212	
213	
214	func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
215		var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
216		var id := s.get_instance_id()
217		tracked.append(id)
218		labels[id] = label
219		s.died.connect(func() -> void: deaths[label] = {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1})
220		return s
221	
222	
223	func _shots_in(sc: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
224		var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
225		for s in shots:
226			if s["scen"] == sc:
227				out.append(s)
228		return out
229	
230	
231	func _gaps(list: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
232		var out := []
233		for i in range(1, list.size()):
234			out.append(int(list[i]["f"]) - int(list[i - 1]["f"]))
235		return out
236	
237	
238	# ---- listeners (read only) ----------------------------------------------------------------------
239	
240	func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
241		var tgt := _aimed_at(arrow)
242		var near := _nearest_in_cone()
243		var ev := {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1, "gt": gt + 1, "act": act + 1, "run": run_id,
244			"pf": Engine.get_process_frames(), "target": _label(tgt), "nearest": _label(near),
245			"in_cone": tgt != null and _in_cone(tgt), "parent_ok": arrow.get_parent() == game.arrows,
246			"paused": paused, "state": game.state}
247		pending.append(ev)
248		shots.append(ev)
249	
250	
251	func _on_state_changed(s: Game.State) -> void:
252		# Emitted by a key the script sends between ticks (restart; dispatch is synchronous): stamp the
253		# current f. Emitted during the nodes' tick (the loss): stamp that tick, f + 1.
254		# (Engine.is_in_physics_frame() cannot tell them apart: the script resumes inside the physics step.)
255		var in_tick := not dispatching_key
256		transitions.append({"scen": scen, "f": f + 1 if in_tick else f, "gt": gt, "state": s,
257			"key": last_key, "key_age": -1 if in_tick else gt - last_key_gt})
258	
259	
260	# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
261	
262	func _step() -> void:
263		next_active = not paused and game.world.process_mode != Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
264		await physics_frame
265		f += 1
266		gt += 1
267		if next_active:
268			act += 1
269		var cd := game.archer.fire_cooldown
270	
271		if not next_active:
272			if not pending.is_empty():
273				inv_inactive_shots += pending.size()
274				inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d shot] " % [scen, f]
275			if cd != prev_cd:
276				inv_inactive_cd_changes += 1
277				inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d cd %.6f->%.6f] " % [scen, f, prev_cd, cd]
278		if arrows_added != pending.size():
279			inv_arrow_mismatch += 1
280			inv_arrow_detail += "[%s f=%d arrows=%d fired=%d] " % [scen, f, arrows_added, pending.size()]
281	
282		var fired_txt := PackedStringArray()
283		for e in pending:
284			fired_txt.append("%s(nearest %s, pf %d)" % [e["target"], e["nearest"], e["pf"]])
285		var sc_txt := PackedStringArray()
286		for id in tracked:
287			var s := _live(id)
288			if s == null:
289				wall_prev.erase(id)
290				continue
291			sc_txt.append("%s y=%.2f wall=%s hp=%.2f burn=%s cone=%s" % [labels[id], s.position.y,
292				s.at_wall, s.hp, s.is_burning(), _in_cone(s)])
293			if wall_prev.has(id) and bool(wall_prev[id][0]) and not is_equal_approx(float(wall_prev[id][1]), s.position.y):
294				inv_wall_moves += 1
295				inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d y %.2f->%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, wall_prev[id][1], s.position.y]
296			if s.at_wall and not is_equal_approx(s.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y):
297				inv_wall_moves += 1
298				inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d at_wall but y=%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, s.position.y]
299			wall_prev[id] = [s.at_wall, s.position.y]
300	
301		print("%d | %s f=%d | state=%s paused=%s x=%.2f cd=%.6f arrows=%d | fired=[%s] | %s" % [
302			Engine.get_process_frames(), scen, f, Game.State.keys()[game.state], paused,
303			game.archer.position.x, cd, _live_arrows(), ", ".join(fired_txt), "; ".join(sc_txt)])
304		pending.clear()
305		arrows_added = 0
306		prev_cd = cd
307	
308	
309	func _begin(name: String) -> void:
310		scen = name
311		f = 0
312		print("---- scenario %s ----" % name)
313	
314	
315	## Wait until no tracked scarecrow (except keep_ids) is alive, no arrow flies and the cooldown is 0.
316	func _settle(keep: Array[int] = []) -> void:
317		var cap := 900
318		while cap > 0:
319			var busy := _live_arrows() > 0 or game.archer.fire_cooldown > 0.0
320			for id in tracked:
321				if not keep.has(id) and _live(id) != null:
322					busy = true
323			if not busy:
324				break
325			await _step()
326			cap -= 1
327		for i in 3:
328			await _step()
329	
330	
331	# ---- scenarios ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
332	
333	## (a) One scarecrow in the cone, cooldown 0: the first shots until it dies.
334	func _scen_a() -> void:
335		_begin("a")
336		var cd0 := game.archer.fire_cooldown
337		var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "A1")
338		var id := s.get_instance_id()
339		var in_cone0 := _in_cone(s)
340		while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
341			await _step()
342		var list := _shots_in("a")
343		var first := int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
344		print("MEASURED a: cooldown at spawn %.6f, in cone at spawn %s, shots at f %s, gaps %s, died at f %s" % [
345			cd0, in_cone0, str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(_gaps(list)),
346			str(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1))])
347		_inv("(a) setup: cooldown 0 and the scarecrow inside the cone at spawn", cd0 == 0.0 and in_cone0)
348		_timing("(a) first fired frame after a spawn in the cone (spawn = f 0)", first, A_FIRST_SHOT_F)
349		_timing("(a) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), A_SHOT_GAPS)
350		_timing("(a) frame the scarecrow dies", int(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1)), A_DEATH_F)
351		await _settle()
352	
353	
354	## (b) Two scarecrows in the cone: which one is taken, and the cadence.
355	func _scen_b() -> void:
356		_begin("b")
357		var near := _spawn(Vector2(600, 350), "B_near")
358		var far := _spawn(Vector2(690, 250), "B_far")
359		var ids: Array[int] = [near.get_instance_id(), far.get_instance_id()]
360		var both_in := _in_cone(near) and _in_cone(far)
361		while (_live(ids[0]) != null or _live(ids[1]) != null) and f < 900:
362			await _step()
363		var list := _shots_in("b")
364		var targets := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> String: return e["target"])
365		print("MEASURED b: shots at f %s, targets %s, gaps %s, B_near died f %s, B_far died f %s" % [
366			str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(targets), str(_gaps(list)),
367			str(deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", -1)), str(deaths.get("B_far", {}).get("f", -1))])
368		_inv("(b) setup: both scarecrows inside the cone at spawn", both_in)
369		var near_first: bool = not list.is_empty() and list[0]["target"] == "B_near"
370		_inv("(b) the first shot takes the nearer scarecrow (B_near)", near_first, "targets %s" % str(targets))
371		var b_near_death: int = deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", 1 << 30)
372		var order_ok := true
373		for e in list:
374			var expect := "B_near" if int(e["f"]) <= b_near_death else "B_far"
375			if e["target"] != expect:
376				order_ok = false
377		_inv("(b) every shot takes B_near while it lives, then B_far", order_ok and list.size() >= 2,
378			"targets %s" % str(targets))
379		_timing("(b) first fired frame after the spawn", int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1,
380			B_FIRST_SHOT_F)
381		_timing("(b) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), B_SHOT_GAPS)
382		await _settle()
383	
384	
385	## (c) The target leaves the cone because the archer moves away (D held), and comes back (A held).
386	func _scen_c() -> void:
387		_begin("c")
388		var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 450), "C1")
389		var id := s.get_instance_id()
390		_key(KEY_D, true)
391		var exit_f := -1
392		var cd_zero_f := -1
393		var reentry_f := -1
394		var moved_ok := 0
395		var moved_bad := 0
396		var moved_detail := ""
397		while _live(id) != null and f < 400:
398			var x0 := game.archer.position.x
399			var cd_before := game.archer.fire_cooldown
400			var holding := f < C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS   # a move key is held for tick f + 1
401			await _step()
402			if holding and cd_before > 1.5 * TICK:
403				var dx := absf(game.archer.position.x - x0)
404				if absf(dx - Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK) < 1e-6:
405					moved_ok += 1
406				else:
407					moved_bad += 1
408					moved_detail += "[f=%d dx=%.4f] " % [f, dx]
409			var c := _live(id)
410			if c != null:
411				var inc := _in_cone(c)
412				if exit_f < 0 and not inc:
413					exit_f = f
414				elif exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and inc:
415					reentry_f = f
416			if exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and cd_zero_f < 0 and game.archer.fire_cooldown == 0.0:
417				cd_zero_f = f
418			if f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS:
419				_key(KEY_D, false)
420				_key(KEY_A, true)
421			elif f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS:
422				_key(KEY_A, false)
423		_key(KEY_D, false)
424		_key(KEY_A, false)
425		var list := _shots_in("c")
426		var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
427		var out_shots := 0
428		var reentry_shot := -1
429		for e in list:
430			if exit_f >= 0 and int(e["f"]) >= exit_f and (reentry_f < 0 or int(e["f"]) < reentry_f):
431				out_shots += 1
432			if reentry_f >= 0 and reentry_shot < 0 and int(e["f"]) >= reentry_f:
433				reentry_shot = int(e["f"])
434		print("MEASURED c: shots at f %s, exit f %d, cooldown 0 at f %d, re-entry f %d, re-entry shot f %d, died f %s" % [
435			str(fs), exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, reentry_shot, str(deaths.get("C1", {}).get("f", -1))])
436		_inv("(c) no shot while the target is outside the cone, though the cooldown is 0",
437			exit_f > 0 and reentry_f > exit_f and cd_zero_f >= exit_f and out_shots == 0,
438			"exit %d cd0 %d reentry %d shots between %d" % [exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, out_shots])
439		_inv("the archer moves %.0f px per tick while the cooldown runs (%d ticks checked)" % [
440			Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK, moved_ok], moved_ok > 0 and moved_bad == 0, moved_detail)
441		_timing("(c) first fired frame after the spawn", int(fs[0]) if not fs.is_empty() else -1, C_FIRST_SHOT_F)
442		_timing("(c) frame the target leaves the cone", exit_f, C_EXIT_F)
443		_timing("(c) frame the cooldown reaches 0 while it is outside", cd_zero_f, C_CD_ZERO_F)
444		_timing("(c) frame the target is back in the cone", reentry_f, C_REENTRY_F)
445		_timing("(c) fired frame - re-entry frame", reentry_shot - reentry_f, C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY)
446		await _settle()
447	
448	
449	## (d) P pressed mid-cooldown, and again D_PAUSE_TICKS frames later.
450	func _scen_d() -> void:
451		_begin("d")
452		var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 250), "D1")
453		var id := s.get_instance_id()
454		var paused_ok := false
455		var resumed_ok := false
456		var frozen_y := true
457		var y_at_pause := 0.0
458		var cd_at_pause := -1.0
459		var cd_after_pause := -1.0
460		while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
461			await _step()
462			var c := _live(id)
463			if f == D_PAUSE_AT_F:
464				cd_at_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
465				y_at_pause = c.position.y if c else 0.0
466				_tap(KEY_P)
467				paused_ok = paused
468			elif f > D_PAUSE_AT_F and f <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
469				if c and not is_equal_approx(c.position.y, y_at_pause):
470					frozen_y = false
471				if f == D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
472					cd_after_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
473					_tap(KEY_P)
474					resumed_ok = not paused
475		var list := _shots_in("d")
476		var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
477		var s1 := int(fs[0]) if fs.size() > 0 else -1
478		var s2 := int(fs[1]) if fs.size() > 1 else -1
479		var paused_shots := 0
480		for e in list:
481			if int(e["f"]) > D_PAUSE_AT_F and int(e["f"]) <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
482				paused_shots += 1
483		var cadence: int = A_SHOT_GAPS[0] if A_SHOT_GAPS.size() > 0 else FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS
484		print("MEASURED d: shots at f %s, gaps %s, cd at pause %.6f, cd after %d paused ticks %.6f, died f %s" % [
485			str(fs), str(_gaps(list)), cd_at_pause, D_PAUSE_TICKS, cd_after_pause,
486			str(deaths.get("D1", {}).get("f", -1))])
487		_inv("(d) P pauses mid-cooldown and P again resumes", paused_ok and resumed_ok and cd_at_pause > 0.0,
488			"paused %s resumed %s cd %.4f" % [paused_ok, resumed_ok, cd_at_pause])
489		_inv("(d) while paused: no shot, the cooldown and the scarecrow do not change",
490			paused_shots == 0 and cd_after_pause == cd_at_pause and frozen_y,
491			"shots %d cd %.6f->%.6f frozen_y %s" % [paused_shots, cd_at_pause, cd_after_pause, frozen_y])
492		_timing("(d) first fired frame", s1, D_SHOT1_F)
493		_timing("(d) second fired frame (after the pause)", s2, D_SHOT2_F)
494		_timing("(d) shift of the second shot by the %d-frame pause" % D_PAUSE_TICKS, s2 - s1 - cadence, D_PAUSE_SHIFT)
495		var later := _gaps(list).slice(1)
496		var later_ok := true
497		for g in later:
498			later_ok = later_ok and int(g) == cadence
499		_inv("(d) shots after the pause keep the unpaused cadence (%d)" % cadence, later_ok, "gaps %s" % str(_gaps(list)))
500		await _settle()
501	
502	
503	## (e) With the archer at the right edge, a scarecrow walks down to the wall outside the cone and stops.
504	func _scen_e() -> void:
505		_begin("e-setup")
506		_key(KEY_D, true)
507		while game.archer.position.x < Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN and f < 300:
508			await _step()
509		_key(KEY_D, false)
510		await _step()
511		_begin("e")
512		var s := _spawn(Vector2(160, 400), "E1")
513		var id := s.get_instance_id()
514		var ever_in_cone := _in_cone(s)
515		var wall_f := -1
516		var hold := 0
517		var gate_at_wall := 0.0
518		while _live(id) != null and f < 600 and hold < E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS:
519			await _step()
520			var c := _live(id)
521			if c == null:
522				break
523			ever_in_cone = ever_in_cone or _in_cone(c)
524			if wall_f < 0 and c.at_wall:
525				wall_f = f
526				gate_at_wall = game.gate_hp
527			elif wall_f >= 0:
528				hold += 1
529		var c2 := _live(id)
530		var still := c2 != null and c2.at_wall and is_equal_approx(c2.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
531		print("MEASURED e: archer x %.2f, at_wall at f %d, y %.2f after %d more frames, gate %.4f -> %.4f" % [
532			game.archer.position.x, wall_f, c2.position.y if c2 else -1.0, hold, gate_at_wall, game.gate_hp])
533		_inv("(e) setup: the scarecrow never enters the cone, no shot", not ever_in_cone and _shots_in("e").is_empty())
534		_inv("(e) the scarecrow at the wall stays at y %.0f for %d frames and hits the gate" % [
535			Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y, E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS], still and hold == E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS and game.gate_hp < gate_at_wall)
536		_timing("(e) frame the scarecrow reaches the wall (spawn at y 400 = f 0)", wall_f, E_WALL_F)
537	
538	
539	## (f) A loss with the archer still firing, then R, then Enter, then the first shot of the new run.
540	func _scen_f() -> void:
541		_begin("f")
542		var t0 := transitions.size()
543		var ax := game.archer.position.x
544		var i := 1
545		for dx in [-60.0, -48.0, -36.0, -24.0]:
546			_spawn(Vector2(ax + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "F%d" % i)
547			i += 1
548		i = 1
549		for x in [300.0, 400.0, 500.0, 600.0, 700.0, 800.0]:
550			_spawn(Vector2(x, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "W%d" % i)
551			i += 1
552		var r_in_play_ok := true
553		while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and f < 900:
554			await _step()
555			if f == 10:
556				var hp := game.gate_hp
557				_tap(KEY_R)
558				r_in_play_ok = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and transitions.size() == t0
559				print("INFO (f) R during play at f 10: state %s, gate %.4f (was %.4f)" % [
560					Game.State.keys()[game.state], game.gate_hp, hp])
561		var loss_f := f
562		var lost := game.state == Game.State.LOST
563		var list := _shots_in("f")
564		var last_shot_f := int(list.back()["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
565		var firing := not list.is_empty() and loss_f - last_shot_f < FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS + 1
566		var cd_at_loss := game.archer.fire_cooldown
567		var x_at_loss := game.archer.position.x
568		var arrows_at_loss := _live_arrows()
569		_tap(KEY_D)   # a move key while the game is over (pressed and released at once)
570		_key(KEY_A, true)
571		for k in F_FROZEN_TICKS:
572			await _step()
573		_key(KEY_A, false)
574		var frozen := game.archer.fire_cooldown == cd_at_loss and game.archer.position.x == x_at_loss \
575				and _live_arrows() == arrows_at_loss and game.state == Game.State.LOST
576		var shots_after_loss := 0
577		for e in _shots_in("f"):
578			if int(e["f"]) > loss_f:
579				shots_after_loss += 1
580		print("MEASURED f: shots at f %s, LOST at f %d, last shot f %d, cd at loss %.6f, %d arrows in flight" % [
581			str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), loss_f, last_shot_f, cd_at_loss, arrows_at_loss])
582	
583		_tap(KEY_R)
584		run_id += 1
585		act = 0
586		var restarted := game.state == Game.State.PLAYING
587		print("INFO (f) R after the loss: state %s, gate %.4f, archer x %.2f, cd %.6f" % [
588			Game.State.keys()[game.state], game.gate_hp, game.archer.position.x, game.archer.fire_cooldown])
589		for k in 5:
590			await _step()
591		var t_before_enter := transitions.size()
592		_tap(KEY_ENTER)
593		var enter_noop := game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and transitions.size() == t_before_enter
594		for k in 5:
595			await _step()
596		var spawn_f := f
597		_spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "G1")
598		var shot_f := -1
599		var n0 := shots.size()
600		while f < spawn_f + 120 and shot_f < 0:
601			await _step()
602			if shots.size() > n0:
603				shot_f = int(shots[n0]["f"])
604		print("MEASURED f: new run: G1 spawned at f %d, first fired at f %d" % [spawn_f, shot_f])
605	
606		var states := transitions.slice(t0).map(func(t: Dictionary) -> int: return t["state"])
607		var tr_txt := transitions.slice(t0).map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String:
608			return "%s@f%d key=%d age=%d" % [Game.State.keys()[t["state"]], t["f"], t["key"], t["key_age"]])
609		print("INFO (f) transitions: %s" % str(tr_txt))
610		var via_key: bool = states.size() == 2 and int(transitions[t0 + 1]["key"]) == KEY_R \
611				and int(transitions[t0 + 1]["key_age"]) == 0 and int(transitions[t0]["key_age"]) == -1 \
612				and int(transitions[t0]["f"]) == loss_f
613		_inv("(f) setup: the run is lost with the archer still firing (a shot within %d frames before)" % [
614			FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS + 1], lost and firing, "lost %s last shot f %d loss f %d" % [lost, last_shot_f, loss_f])
615		_inv("(f) R during play does nothing", r_in_play_ok)
616		_inv("(f) after the loss: no shot, cooldown, archer x and arrows frozen, keys ignored, state stays LOST",
617			frozen and shots_after_loss == 0, "frozen %s shots after %d" % [frozen, shots_after_loss])
618		_inv("(f) run states go PLAYING -> LOST -> PLAYING, the last only on the R press", restarted and via_key
619			and states == [Game.State.LOST, Game.State.PLAYING], str(tr_txt))
620		_inv("(f) Enter right after the restart (state PLAYING) does nothing", enter_noop)
621		_timing("(f) frame the run is LOST", loss_f, F_LOSS_F)
622		_timing("(f) new run: fired frame - spawn frame", shot_f - spawn_f, F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY)
623	
624	
625	# ---- invariants over every shot of the whole test ------------------------------------------------
626	
627	func _global_invariants() -> void:
628		var no_target := PackedStringArray()
629		var not_nearest := PackedStringArray()
630		var bad_parent := 0
631		var during_pause := 0
632		for e in shots:
633			if e["target"] == "none" or not e["in_cone"]:
634				no_target.append("%s f%d" % [e["scen"], e["f"]])
635			if e["target"] != e["nearest"]:
636				not_nearest.append("%s f%d %s!=%s" % [e["scen"], e["f"], e["target"], e["nearest"]])
637			if not e["parent_ok"]:
638				bad_parent += 1
639			if e["paused"] or e["state"] != Game.State.PLAYING:
640				during_pause += 1
641		var close := PackedStringArray()
642		var min_gap := 1 << 30
643		for k in range(1, shots.size()):
644			if shots[k]["run"] != shots[k - 1]["run"]:
645				continue
646			var g := int(shots[k]["act"]) - int(shots[k - 1]["act"])
647			min_gap = mini(min_gap, g)
648			if g * TICK < Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL - 1e-9:
649				close.append("%s f%d gap %d" % [shots[k]["scen"], shots[k]["f"], g])
650		print("INFO %d shots in total; smallest gap in archer-active frames within a run: %d" % [shots.size(), min_gap])
651		_inv("no shot without a target in the cone (%d shots)" % shots.size(), no_target.is_empty(), str(no_target))
652		_inv("never two shots closer than FIRE_INTERVAL in archer-active frames (min %d)" % min_gap, close.is_empty(),
653			str(close))
654		_inv("exactly one arrow under World/Arrows per fired, in the same frame",
655			inv_arrow_mismatch == 0 and bad_parent == 0, inv_arrow_detail)
656		_inv("no shot and no cooldown change on a frame the archer is paused or the game has ended",
657			inv_inactive_shots == 0 and inv_inactive_cd_changes == 0 and during_pause == 0, inv_inactive_detail)
658		_inv("every shot takes the nearest scarecrow in the cone", not_nearest.is_empty(), str(not_nearest))
659		_inv("a scarecrow at the wall never moves", inv_wall_moves == 0, inv_wall_detail)

extends SceneTree
## Step 2 pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §5, §10): what the archer does NOW, before any clip exists.
## Drives the real main scene only through keyboard events (Input.parse_input_event); never calls an
## archer or scarecrow method that changes state, never assigns to their variables. It only spawns
## scarecrows with Game.spawn_scarecrow() and reads state.
##   ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
##
## Frame model. --fixed-fps 60 and 60 physics ticks/s: one main-loop iteration = one physics tick.
## The script resumes on SceneTree.physics_frame, which is emitted BEFORE the nodes' physics step.
## So at each resume the world shows the result of the previous tick, and whatever the script does
## there (keys, spawns) takes effect in the next tick. A scenario's frame f counts game ticks
## completed since the scenario's setup (f = 0 is the setup itself). An event emitted during a
## tick (fired, died) is stamped with that tick's f and shows up in the log line of the same f.
## Every log line begins with Engine.get_process_frames() at the moment it is printed. Measured: an
## event emitted during the tick reports a process frame one lower (line "4 | a f=1" carries
## "fired ... pf 3"), so line P shows the state left by the physics tick of process frame P - 1.
##
## TIMING = numbers the brief changes on purpose (§5); re-pinned in Step 6.
## INVARIANT = must survive the change.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0
const FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS := 36            # Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL (0.6 s) at 60 ticks/s

# ---- scenario design (chosen, not measured) ----------------------------------------------------
const C_HOLD_D_TICKS := 40                 # (c) D held for ticks 1..40, then A for ticks 41..80
const C_HOLD_A_TICKS := 40
const D_PAUSE_AT_F := 15                   # (d) P pressed after tick 15 ...
const D_PAUSE_TICKS := 30                  # ... and again 30 ticks later
const E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS := 30              # (e) ticks watched after the scarecrow reaches the wall
const F_FROZEN_TICKS := 30                 # (f) ticks watched after the loss before R

# ---- TIMING: measured on baseline 2026-11-21 ----------------------------------------------------
const A_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) spawn (in the cone, cooldown 0) at f 0 -> first fired
const A_SHOT_GAPS := [36, 36, 36]          # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) shots at f 1, 37, 73, 109
const A_DEATH_F := 118                     # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) the 4th arrow kills it
const B_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
const B_SHOT_GAPS := [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36]   # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 4 on B_near, 4 on B_far
const C_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
const C_EXIT_F := 26                       # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame the target is outside the cone
const C_CD_ZERO_F := 37                    # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame the cooldown is 0 while it is outside
const C_REENTRY_F := 62                    # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame it is back inside the cone
const C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY := 0            # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: fired on the re-entry frame itself
const D_SHOT1_F := 1                       # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
const D_SHOT2_F := 67                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 1 + 36 + 30 paused frames
const D_PAUSE_SHIFT := 30                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (shot2 - shot1) - unpaused cadence
const E_WALL_F := 174                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 130 px at 0.75 px/tick, rounded up
const F_LOSS_F := 104                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: frame the run is LOST
const F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY := 1            # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: new run, spawn at f_s -> fired at f_s + 1

var game: Game
var timing: Array[String] = []
var invariant: Array[String] = []
var passed := 0
var failed := 0

var scen := ""
var f := 0                 # ticks completed since the scenario's setup
var gt := 0                # ticks completed since the test started
var run_id := 0            # incremented by each restart
var act := 0               # ticks the archer processed (not paused, World enabled) in this run
var next_active := true    # will the archer process the coming tick?
var prev_cd := 0.0
var pending: Array[Dictionary] = []   # fired events since the last log line
var shots: Array[Dictionary] = []     # every fired event
var arrows_added := 0                 # arrows that entered World/Arrows since the last log line
var tracked: Array[int] = []          # scarecrow instance ids
var labels := {}                      # id -> label
var deaths := {}                      # label -> {scen, f}
var wall_prev := {}                   # id -> [at_wall, y] at the previous log line
var transitions: Array[Dictionary] = []
var last_key := -1
var last_key_gt := -1
var dispatching_key := false

# invariant counters, whole run
var inv_inactive_shots := 0
var inv_inactive_cd_changes := 0
var inv_inactive_detail := ""
var inv_arrow_mismatch := 0
var inv_arrow_detail := ""
var inv_wall_moves := 0
var inv_wall_detail := ""


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	game.archer.fired.connect(_on_fired)
	game.arrows.child_entered_tree.connect(func(_n: Node) -> void: arrows_added += 1)
	game.state_changed.connect(_on_state_changed)
	await process_frame
	scen = "boot"
	for i in 3:
		await _step()

	await _scen_a()
	await _scen_b()
	await _scen_c()
	await _scen_d()
	await _scen_e()
	await _scen_f()
	_global_invariants()

	print("== TIMING (changed on purpose by brief §5; re-pinned in Step 6) ==")
	for line in timing:
		print(line)
	print("== INVARIANT (must survive the change) ==")
	for line in invariant:
		print(line)
	print("RESULT test_pins_a7: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# ---- checks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _record(group: Array[String], name: String, ok: bool, detail: String) -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		group.append("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		group.append("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _timing(name: String, measured: Variant, pinned: Variant) -> void:
	_record(timing, "%s = %s" % [name, str(pinned)], measured == pinned, "measured %s" % str(measured))


func _inv(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	_record(invariant, name, ok, detail)


# ---- input --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	if pressed:
		last_key = code
		last_key_gt = gt
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	dispatching_key = true
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	dispatching_key = false


func _tap(code: Key) -> void:
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)


# ---- reading the world --------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _in_cone(s: Scarecrow) -> bool:
	var to := s.global_position - game.archer.global_position
	return absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) <= deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)


func _live(id: int) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow
	if s == null or not s.is_inside_tree() or s.is_queued_for_deletion() or s.is_dead():
		return null
	return s


func _nearest_in_cone() -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_d := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead() or not _in_cone(s):
			continue
		var d := (s.global_position - game.archer.global_position).length()
		if d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = s
	return best


func _aimed_at(arrow: Arrow) -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_a := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead():
			continue
		var a := absf(arrow.velocity.angle_to(s.global_position - arrow.position))
		if a < best_a:
			best_a = a
			best = s
	return best if best_a < 1e-3 else null


func _label(s: Scarecrow) -> String:
	return "none" if s == null else str(labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"))


func _live_arrows() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in game.arrows.get_children():
		if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
			n += 1
	return n


func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	tracked.append(id)
	labels[id] = label
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: deaths[label] = {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1})
	return s


func _shots_in(sc: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for s in shots:
		if s["scen"] == sc:
			out.append(s)
	return out


func _gaps(list: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
	var out := []
	for i in range(1, list.size()):
		out.append(int(list[i]["f"]) - int(list[i - 1]["f"]))
	return out


# ---- listeners (read only) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
	var tgt := _aimed_at(arrow)
	var near := _nearest_in_cone()
	var ev := {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1, "gt": gt + 1, "act": act + 1, "run": run_id,
		"pf": Engine.get_process_frames(), "target": _label(tgt), "nearest": _label(near),
		"in_cone": tgt != null and _in_cone(tgt), "parent_ok": arrow.get_parent() == game.arrows,
		"paused": paused, "state": game.state}
	pending.append(ev)
	shots.append(ev)


func _on_state_changed(s: Game.State) -> void:
	# Emitted by a key the script sends between ticks (restart; dispatch is synchronous): stamp the
	# current f. Emitted during the nodes' tick (the loss): stamp that tick, f + 1.
	# (Engine.is_in_physics_frame() cannot tell them apart: the script resumes inside the physics step.)
	var in_tick := not dispatching_key
	transitions.append({"scen": scen, "f": f + 1 if in_tick else f, "gt": gt, "state": s,
		"key": last_key, "key_age": -1 if in_tick else gt - last_key_gt})


# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _step() -> void:
	next_active = not paused and game.world.process_mode != Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await physics_frame
	f += 1
	gt += 1
	if next_active:
		act += 1
	var cd := game.archer.fire_cooldown

	if not next_active:
		if not pending.is_empty():
			inv_inactive_shots += pending.size()
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d shot] " % [scen, f]
		if cd != prev_cd:
			inv_inactive_cd_changes += 1
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d cd %.6f->%.6f] " % [scen, f, prev_cd, cd]
	if arrows_added != pending.size():
		inv_arrow_mismatch += 1
		inv_arrow_detail += "[%s f=%d arrows=%d fired=%d] " % [scen, f, arrows_added, pending.size()]

	var fired_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for e in pending:
		fired_txt.append("%s(nearest %s, pf %d)" % [e["target"], e["nearest"], e["pf"]])
	var sc_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for id in tracked:
		var s := _live(id)
		if s == null:
			wall_prev.erase(id)
			continue
		sc_txt.append("%s y=%.2f wall=%s hp=%.2f burn=%s cone=%s" % [labels[id], s.position.y,
			s.at_wall, s.hp, s.is_burning(), _in_cone(s)])
		if wall_prev.has(id) and bool(wall_prev[id][0]) and not is_equal_approx(float(wall_prev[id][1]), s.position.y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d y %.2f->%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, wall_prev[id][1], s.position.y]
		if s.at_wall and not is_equal_approx(s.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d at_wall but y=%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, s.position.y]
		wall_prev[id] = [s.at_wall, s.position.y]

	print("%d | %s f=%d | state=%s paused=%s x=%.2f cd=%.6f arrows=%d | fired=[%s] | %s" % [
		Engine.get_process_frames(), scen, f, Game.State.keys()[game.state], paused,
		game.archer.position.x, cd, _live_arrows(), ", ".join(fired_txt), "; ".join(sc_txt)])
	pending.clear()
	arrows_added = 0
	prev_cd = cd


func _begin(name: String) -> void:
	scen = name
	f = 0
	print("---- scenario %s ----" % name)


## Wait until no tracked scarecrow (except keep_ids) is alive, no arrow flies and the cooldown is 0.
func _settle(keep: Array[int] = []) -> void:
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0:
		var busy := _live_arrows() > 0 or game.archer.fire_cooldown > 0.0
		for id in tracked:
			if not keep.has(id) and _live(id) != null:
				busy = true
		if not busy:
			break
		await _step()
		cap -= 1
	for i in 3:
		await _step()


# ---- scenarios ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## (a) One scarecrow in the cone, cooldown 0: the first shots until it dies.
func _scen_a() -> void:
	_begin("a")
	var cd0 := game.archer.fire_cooldown
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "A1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var in_cone0 := _in_cone(s)
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
		await _step()
	var list := _shots_in("a")
	var first := int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
	print("MEASURED a: cooldown at spawn %.6f, in cone at spawn %s, shots at f %s, gaps %s, died at f %s" % [
		cd0, in_cone0, str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(_gaps(list)),
		str(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(a) setup: cooldown 0 and the scarecrow inside the cone at spawn", cd0 == 0.0 and in_cone0)
	_timing("(a) first fired frame after a spawn in the cone (spawn = f 0)", first, A_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(a) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), A_SHOT_GAPS)
	_timing("(a) frame the scarecrow dies", int(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1)), A_DEATH_F)
	await _settle()


## (b) Two scarecrows in the cone: which one is taken, and the cadence.
func _scen_b() -> void:
	_begin("b")
	var near := _spawn(Vector2(600, 350), "B_near")
	var far := _spawn(Vector2(690, 250), "B_far")
	var ids: Array[int] = [near.get_instance_id(), far.get_instance_id()]
	var both_in := _in_cone(near) and _in_cone(far)
	while (_live(ids[0]) != null or _live(ids[1]) != null) and f < 900:
		await _step()
	var list := _shots_in("b")
	var targets := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> String: return e["target"])
	print("MEASURED b: shots at f %s, targets %s, gaps %s, B_near died f %s, B_far died f %s" % [
		str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(targets), str(_gaps(list)),
		str(deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", -1)), str(deaths.get("B_far", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(b) setup: both scarecrows inside the cone at spawn", both_in)
	var near_first: bool = not list.is_empty() and list[0]["target"] == "B_near"
	_inv("(b) the first shot takes the nearer scarecrow (B_near)", near_first, "targets %s" % str(targets))
	var b_near_death: int = deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", 1 << 30)
	var order_ok := true
	for e in list:
		var expect := "B_near" if int(e["f"]) <= b_near_death else "B_far"
		if e["target"] != expect:
			order_ok = false
	_inv("(b) every shot takes B_near while it lives, then B_far", order_ok and list.size() >= 2,
		"targets %s" % str(targets))
	_timing("(b) first fired frame after the spawn", int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1,
		B_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(b) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), B_SHOT_GAPS)
	await _settle()


## (c) The target leaves the cone because the archer moves away (D held), and comes back (A held).
func _scen_c() -> void:
	_begin("c")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 450), "C1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	var exit_f := -1
	var cd_zero_f := -1
	var reentry_f := -1
	var moved_ok := 0
	var moved_bad := 0
	var moved_detail := ""
	while _live(id) != null and f < 400:
		var x0 := game.archer.position.x
		var cd_before := game.archer.fire_cooldown
		var holding := f < C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS   # a move key is held for tick f + 1
		await _step()
		if holding and cd_before > 1.5 * TICK:
			var dx := absf(game.archer.position.x - x0)
			if absf(dx - Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK) < 1e-6:
				moved_ok += 1
			else:
				moved_bad += 1
				moved_detail += "[f=%d dx=%.4f] " % [f, dx]
		var c := _live(id)
		if c != null:
			var inc := _in_cone(c)
			if exit_f < 0 and not inc:
				exit_f = f
			elif exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and inc:
				reentry_f = f
		if exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and cd_zero_f < 0 and game.archer.fire_cooldown == 0.0:
			cd_zero_f = f
		if f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS:
			_key(KEY_D, false)
			_key(KEY_A, true)
		elif f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS:
			_key(KEY_A, false)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	var list := _shots_in("c")
	var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
	var out_shots := 0
	var reentry_shot := -1
	for e in list:
		if exit_f >= 0 and int(e["f"]) >= exit_f and (reentry_f < 0 or int(e["f"]) < reentry_f):
			out_shots += 1
		if reentry_f >= 0 and reentry_shot < 0 and int(e["f"]) >= reentry_f:
			reentry_shot = int(e["f"])
	print("MEASURED c: shots at f %s, exit f %d, cooldown 0 at f %d, re-entry f %d, re-entry shot f %d, died f %s" % [
		str(fs), exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, reentry_shot, str(deaths.get("C1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(c) no shot while the target is outside the cone, though the cooldown is 0",
		exit_f > 0 and reentry_f > exit_f and cd_zero_f >= exit_f and out_shots == 0,
		"exit %d cd0 %d reentry %d shots between %d" % [exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, out_shots])
	_inv("the archer moves %.0f px per tick while the cooldown runs (%d ticks checked)" % [
		Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK, moved_ok], moved_ok > 0 and moved_bad == 0, moved_detail)
	_timing("(c) first fired frame after the spawn", int(fs[0]) if not fs.is_empty() else -1, C_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the target leaves the cone", exit_f, C_EXIT_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the cooldown reaches 0 while it is outside", cd_zero_f, C_CD_ZERO_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the target is back in the cone", reentry_f, C_REENTRY_F)
	_timing("(c) fired frame - re-entry frame", reentry_shot - reentry_f, C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY)
	await _settle()


## (d) P pressed mid-cooldown, and again D_PAUSE_TICKS frames later.
func _scen_d() -> void:
	_begin("d")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 250), "D1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var paused_ok := false
	var resumed_ok := false
	var frozen_y := true
	var y_at_pause := 0.0
	var cd_at_pause := -1.0
	var cd_after_pause := -1.0
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
		await _step()
		var c := _live(id)
		if f == D_PAUSE_AT_F:
			cd_at_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
			y_at_pause = c.position.y if c else 0.0
			_tap(KEY_P)
			paused_ok = paused
		elif f > D_PAUSE_AT_F and f <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
			if c and not is_equal_approx(c.position.y, y_at_pause):
				frozen_y = false
			if f == D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
				cd_after_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
				_tap(KEY_P)
				resumed_ok = not paused
	var list := _shots_in("d")
	var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
	var s1 := int(fs[0]) if fs.size() > 0 else -1
	var s2 := int(fs[1]) if fs.size() > 1 else -1
	var paused_shots := 0
	for e in list:
		if int(e["f"]) > D_PAUSE_AT_F and int(e["f"]) <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
			paused_shots += 1
	var cadence: int = A_SHOT_GAPS[0] if A_SHOT_GAPS.size() > 0 else FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS
	print("MEASURED d: shots at f %s, gaps %s, cd at pause %.6f, cd after %d paused ticks %.6f, died f %s" % [
		str(fs), str(_gaps(list)), cd_at_pause, D_PAUSE_TICKS, cd_after_pause,
		str(deaths.get("D1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(d) P pauses mid-cooldown and P again resumes", paused_ok and resumed_ok and cd_at_pause > 0.0,
		"paused %s resumed %s cd %.4f" % [paused_ok, resumed_ok, cd_at_pause])
	_inv("(d) while paused: no shot, the cooldown and the scarecrow do not change",
		paused_shots == 0 and cd_after_pause == cd_at_pause and frozen_y,
		"shots %d cd %.6f->%.6f frozen_y %s" % [paused_shots, cd_at_pause, cd_after_pause, frozen_y])
	_timing("(d) first fired frame", s1, D_SHOT1_F)
	_timing("(d) second fired frame (after the pause)", s2, D_SHOT2_F)
	_timing("(d) shift of the second shot by the %d-frame pause" % D_PAUSE_TICKS, s2 - s1 - cadence, D_PAUSE_SHIFT)
	var later := _gaps(list).slice(1)
	var later_ok := true
	for g in later:
		later_ok = later_ok and int(g) == cadence
	_inv("(d) shots after the pause keep the unpaused cadence (%d)" % cadence, later_ok, "gaps %s" % str(_gaps(list)))
	await _settle()


## (e) With the archer at the right edge, a scarecrow walks down to the wall outside the cone and stops.
func _scen_e() -> void:
	_begin("e-setup")
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	while game.archer.position.x < Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN and f < 300:
		await _step()
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	await _step()
	_begin("e")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(160, 400), "E1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var ever_in_cone := _in_cone(s)
	var wall_f := -1
	var hold := 0
	var gate_at_wall := 0.0
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600 and hold < E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS:
		await _step()
		var c := _live(id)
		if c == null:
			break
		ever_in_cone = ever_in_cone or _in_cone(c)
		if wall_f < 0 and c.at_wall:
			wall_f = f
			gate_at_wall = game.gate_hp
		elif wall_f >= 0:
			hold += 1
	var c2 := _live(id)
	var still := c2 != null and c2.at_wall and is_equal_approx(c2.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
	print("MEASURED e: archer x %.2f, at_wall at f %d, y %.2f after %d more frames, gate %.4f -> %.4f" % [
		game.archer.position.x, wall_f, c2.position.y if c2 else -1.0, hold, gate_at_wall, game.gate_hp])
	_inv("(e) setup: the scarecrow never enters the cone, no shot", not ever_in_cone and _shots_in("e").is_empty())
	_inv("(e) the scarecrow at the wall stays at y %.0f for %d frames and hits the gate" % [
		Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y, E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS], still and hold == E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS and game.gate_hp < gate_at_wall)
	_timing("(e) frame the scarecrow reaches the wall (spawn at y 400 = f 0)", wall_f, E_WALL_F)


## (f) A loss with the archer still firing, then R, then Enter, then the first shot of the new run.
func _scen_f() -> void:
	_begin("f")
	var t0 := transitions.size()
	var ax := game.archer.position.x
	var i := 1
	for dx in [-60.0, -48.0, -36.0, -24.0]:
		_spawn(Vector2(ax + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "F%d" % i)
		i += 1
	i = 1
	for x in [300.0, 400.0, 500.0, 600.0, 700.0, 800.0]:
		_spawn(Vector2(x, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "W%d" % i)
		i += 1
	var r_in_play_ok := true
	while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and f < 900:
		await _step()
		if f == 10:
			var hp := game.gate_hp
			_tap(KEY_R)
			r_in_play_ok = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and transitions.size() == t0
			print("INFO (f) R during play at f 10: state %s, gate %.4f (was %.4f)" % [
				Game.State.keys()[game.state], game.gate_hp, hp])
	var loss_f := f
	var lost := game.state == Game.State.LOST
	var list := _shots_in("f")
	var last_shot_f := int(list.back()["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
	var firing := not list.is_empty() and loss_f - last_shot_f < FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS + 1
	var cd_at_loss := game.archer.fire_cooldown
	var x_at_loss := game.archer.position.x
	var arrows_at_loss := _live_arrows()
	_tap(KEY_D)   # a move key while the game is over (pressed and released at once)
	_key(KEY_A, true)
	for k in F_FROZEN_TICKS:
		await _step()
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	var frozen := game.archer.fire_cooldown == cd_at_loss and game.archer.position.x == x_at_loss \
			and _live_arrows() == arrows_at_loss and game.state == Game.State.LOST
	var shots_after_loss := 0
	for e in _shots_in("f"):
		if int(e["f"]) > loss_f:
			shots_after_loss += 1
	print("MEASURED f: shots at f %s, LOST at f %d, last shot f %d, cd at loss %.6f, %d arrows in flight" % [
		str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), loss_f, last_shot_f, cd_at_loss, arrows_at_loss])

	_tap(KEY_R)
	run_id += 1
	act = 0
	var restarted := game.state == Game.State.PLAYING
	print("INFO (f) R after the loss: state %s, gate %.4f, archer x %.2f, cd %.6f" % [
		Game.State.keys()[game.state], game.gate_hp, game.archer.position.x, game.archer.fire_cooldown])
	for k in 5:
		await _step()
	var t_before_enter := transitions.size()
	_tap(KEY_ENTER)
	var enter_noop := game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and transitions.size() == t_before_enter
	for k in 5:
		await _step()
	var spawn_f := f
	_spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "G1")
	var shot_f := -1
	var n0 := shots.size()
	while f < spawn_f + 120 and shot_f < 0:
		await _step()
		if shots.size() > n0:
			shot_f = int(shots[n0]["f"])
	print("MEASURED f: new run: G1 spawned at f %d, first fired at f %d" % [spawn_f, shot_f])

	var states := transitions.slice(t0).map(func(t: Dictionary) -> int: return t["state"])
	var tr_txt := transitions.slice(t0).map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String:
		return "%s@f%d key=%d age=%d" % [Game.State.keys()[t["state"]], t["f"], t["key"], t["key_age"]])
	print("INFO (f) transitions: %s" % str(tr_txt))
	var via_key: bool = states.size() == 2 and int(transitions[t0 + 1]["key"]) == KEY_R \
			and int(transitions[t0 + 1]["key_age"]) == 0 and int(transitions[t0]["key_age"]) == -1 \
			and int(transitions[t0]["f"]) == loss_f
	_inv("(f) setup: the run is lost with the archer still firing (a shot within %d frames before)" % [
		FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS + 1], lost and firing, "lost %s last shot f %d loss f %d" % [lost, last_shot_f, loss_f])
	_inv("(f) R during play does nothing", r_in_play_ok)
	_inv("(f) after the loss: no shot, cooldown, archer x and arrows frozen, keys ignored, state stays LOST",
		frozen and shots_after_loss == 0, "frozen %s shots after %d" % [frozen, shots_after_loss])
	_inv("(f) run states go PLAYING -> LOST -> PLAYING, the last only on the R press", restarted and via_key
		and states == [Game.State.LOST, Game.State.PLAYING], str(tr_txt))
	_inv("(f) Enter right after the restart (state PLAYING) does nothing", enter_noop)
	_timing("(f) frame the run is LOST", loss_f, F_LOSS_F)
	_timing("(f) new run: fired frame - spawn frame", shot_f - spawn_f, F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY)


# ---- invariants over every shot of the whole test ------------------------------------------------

func _global_invariants() -> void:
	var no_target := PackedStringArray()
	var not_nearest := PackedStringArray()
	var bad_parent := 0
	var during_pause := 0
	for e in shots:
		if e["target"] == "none" or not e["in_cone"]:
			no_target.append("%s f%d" % [e["scen"], e["f"]])
		if e["target"] != e["nearest"]:
			not_nearest.append("%s f%d %s!=%s" % [e["scen"], e["f"], e["target"], e["nearest"]])
		if not e["parent_ok"]:
			bad_parent += 1
		if e["paused"] or e["state"] != Game.State.PLAYING:
			during_pause += 1
	var close := PackedStringArray()
	var min_gap := 1 << 30
	for k in range(1, shots.size()):
		if shots[k]["run"] != shots[k - 1]["run"]:
			continue
		var g := int(shots[k]["act"]) - int(shots[k - 1]["act"])
		min_gap = mini(min_gap, g)
		if g * TICK < Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL - 1e-9:
			close.append("%s f%d gap %d" % [shots[k]["scen"], shots[k]["f"], g])
	print("INFO %d shots in total; smallest gap in archer-active frames within a run: %d" % [shots.size(), min_gap])
	_inv("no shot without a target in the cone (%d shots)" % shots.size(), no_target.is_empty(), str(no_target))
	_inv("never two shots closer than FIRE_INTERVAL in archer-active frames (min %d)" % min_gap, close.is_empty(),
		str(close))
	_inv("exactly one arrow under World/Arrows per fired, in the same frame",
		inv_arrow_mismatch == 0 and bad_parent == 0, inv_arrow_detail)
	_inv("no shot and no cooldown change on a frame the archer is paused or the game has ended",
		inv_inactive_shots == 0 and inv_inactive_cd_changes == 0 and during_pause == 0, inv_inactive_detail)
	_inv("every shot takes the nearest scarecrow in the cone", not_nearest.is_empty(), str(not_nearest))
	_inv("a scarecrow at the wall never moves", inv_wall_moves == 0, inv_wall_detail)

extends SceneTree
## Burning-tint checks (CHANGE-BRIEF Rules 1-6), run through the real main scene and game loop.
##   godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/test_burning_tint.gd --fixed-fps <30|60|144>
## Every ignition is an arrow from the archer's own auto-fire, steered into and out of the cone
## with real A/D key events; pause is a real P key. burn_mix is read from each scarecrow's own
## ShaderMaterial by a Sampler that runs last in every frame. Headless draws nothing: this proves
## the uniform values the renderer is given, not the pixels.
## Prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/burning_tint.gdshader"
const PEAK := 0.65                # Rule 1
const DURATION := 4.0             # Rule 2: burn_mix = 0.65 * clamp(burn_time_left / 4, 0, 1)
const EPS := 1e-6                 # revision A: every frame matches that formula to 1e-6
const GONE := -1.0                # sample of a scarecrow that no longer exists
const UNSET := -2.0               # burn_mix never set on the material (reads back null)
const MAX_FRAMES := 5000
## Just outside the cone of an archer at ARCHER_START: about 60 px of D brings it in, close
## enough that the arrow (aimed at where the scarecrow was) still lands as it walks down.
const TARGET := Vector2(958, 423)
## Higher up, so it is still well above the wall walk when the second arrow is steered in.
const RETRIGGER_TARGET := Vector2(1067, 360)
const STEER_BACK := 40.0          # px of A after the shot; out of the cone long before the cooldown

var passed := 0
var failed := 0
var game: Game
var sampler: Sampler
var rec := {"fired": 0}


## Runs last in every frame (process_priority 1000), also while paused. Holds instance ids and
## numbers only: no reference to a scarecrow, Sprite or material survives between frames.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var ids: Array[int] = []
	var clock := 0.0                         # game time: physics deltas summed while not paused
	var ticks := 0
	var t := PackedFloat64Array()            # clock at each sample
	var dt := PackedFloat64Array()           # game time the physics ticks of this frame advanced
	var frame_dt := PackedFloat64Array()     # _process delta: one frame period, time_scale / fps
	var nticks := PackedInt32Array()
	var paused := PackedByteArray()
	var mix: Array[PackedFloat64Array] = []
	var btl: Array[PackedFloat64Array] = []
	var checked := 0                         # samples of a live scarecrow, over the whole run
	var bad := 0                             # of those: outside [0, 0.65] or off the formula
	var first_bad := PackedFloat64Array()    # [burn_mix, burn_time_left] of the first bad one
	var _clock_last := 0.0
	var _ticks_last := 0

	func _init() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

	func watch(new_ids: Array[int]) -> void:
		ids = new_ids
		t.clear()
		dt.clear()
		frame_dt.clear()
		nticks.clear()
		paused.clear()
		mix = []
		btl = []
		for i in ids.size():
			mix.append(PackedFloat64Array())
			btl.append(PackedFloat64Array())

	func size() -> int:
		return t.size()

	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not get_tree().paused:
			clock += delta
			ticks += 1

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		t.append(clock)
		dt.append(clock - _clock_last)
		nticks.append(ticks - _ticks_last)
		frame_dt.append(delta)
		paused.append(1 if get_tree().paused else 0)
		_clock_last = clock
		_ticks_last = ticks
		for i in ids.size():
			var s := instance_from_id(ids[i]) as Scarecrow
			if s == null:
				mix[i].append(GONE)
				btl[i].append(GONE)
				continue
			var mat := (s.get_node("Sprite") as Sprite2D).material as ShaderMaterial
			var v: Variant = mat.get_shader_parameter("burn_mix")
			var m: float = UNSET if v == null else float(v)
			var left := s.burn_time_left
			mix[i].append(m)
			btl[i].append(left)
			checked += 1
			var expect := PEAK * clampf(left / DURATION, 0.0, 1.0)
			if m < 0.0 or m > PEAK or absf(m - expect) > EPS:
				bad += 1
				if first_bad.is_empty():
					first_bad = PackedFloat64Array([m, left])


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	root.add_child(sampler)
	game.archer.fired.connect(func(_a: Arrow) -> void: rec.fired += 1)
	await process_frame

	_test_shader_uniforms()
	_test_shader_source()
	await _test_instances_independent()
	await _test_single_burn(1.0)
	await _test_single_burn(0.5)
	await _test_single_burn(2.0)
	await _test_pause_freezes()
	await _test_retrigger_then_death()
	_check("every sample of a live scarecrow: 0 <= burn_mix <= 0.65 and == 0.65*clamp(left/4,0,1) (1e-6)",
			sampler.bad == 0 and sampler.checked > 0,
			"%d of %d bad, first [burn_mix, left] = %s" % [sampler.bad, sampler.checked, sampler.first_bad])

	Engine.time_scale = 1.0
	print("test_burning_tint: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


## Clean field at the given time scale: keys up, spawning off, nothing watched.
func _fresh(scale: float) -> void:
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	Engine.time_scale = scale
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	game.reset()
	sampler.watch([])
	await process_frame
	await process_frame          # a time_scale change applies from the next tick


## Spawns scarecrows the way the game does, lets each driver run once, then samples them.
func _spawn_watched(points: Array[Vector2]) -> Array[int]:
	var ids: Array[int] = []
	for p in points:
		ids.append(game.spawn_scarecrow(p).get_instance_id())
	await process_frame
	sampler.watch(ids)
	await process_frame
	return ids


## One real arrow: hold D until the archer's own auto-fire looses one, then hold A until the
## archer is STEER_BACK px back. Keys go in at the start of a physics tick. Returns false if
## no arrow was fired.
func _steer_one_arrow() -> bool:
	var start: int = rec.fired
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	var n := 0
	while rec.fired == start and n < MAX_FRAMES:
		await physics_frame
		n += 1
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	if rec.fired == start:
		return false
	var x_fire := game.archer.position.x
	_key(KEY_A, true)
	while game.archer.position.x > x_fire - STEER_BACK and n < MAX_FRAMES:
		await physics_frame
		n += 1
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	return true


## Steers one arrow in and returns the sample index of its hit on scarecrow i, or -1.
func _arrow_hit(i: int) -> int:
	var k0 := sampler.size()
	if not await _steer_one_arrow():
		return -1
	return await _await_rise(i, k0)


## First sample index >= from_k at which scarecrow i's burn_mix rose (an arrow hit), or -1.
func _await_rise(i: int, from_k: int) -> int:
	var k := maxi(from_k, 1)
	for n in MAX_FRAMES:
		while k < sampler.size():
			if sampler.mix[i][k] > sampler.mix[i][k - 1]:
				return k
			k += 1
		await process_frame
	return -1


## First sample index >= from_k at which scarecrow i's burn_mix is exactly 0.0, or -1.
func _await_zero(i: int, from_k: int) -> int:
	var k := from_k
	for n in MAX_FRAMES:
		while k < sampler.size():
			if sampler.mix[i][k] == 0.0:
				return k
			k += 1
		await process_frame
	return -1


## Revision A: the first frame after a hit shows >= 0.65*(1 - g/4), g = game time that frame
## advanced; a frame with at most one physics tick shows exactly 0.65.
func _peak_ok(i: int, k: int) -> bool:
	var m := sampler.mix[i][k]
	if sampler.nticks[k] <= 1:
		return absf(m - PEAK) <= EPS
	return m >= PEAK * (1.0 - sampler.dt[k] / DURATION) - EPS and m <= PEAK


func _all_equal(i: int, from_k: int, to_k: int, value: float) -> bool:
	for k in range(from_k, to_k):
		if sampler.mix[i][k] != value:
			return false
	return true


func _fps(k: int) -> int:
	return roundi(Engine.time_scale / sampler.frame_dt[k])


## Material facts as numbers. Not a coroutine, so no reference to a material outlives the call.
## Returns [material id or 0, shader id or 0, shader path ok, burn_color unset].
func _material_info(id: int) -> Array:
	var mat := (instance_from_id(id).get_node("Sprite") as Sprite2D).material as ShaderMaterial
	if mat == null or mat.shader == null:
		return [0, 0, false, false]
	return [mat.get_instance_id(), mat.shader.get_instance_id(), mat.shader.resource_path == SHADER_PATH,
			mat.get_shader_parameter("burn_color") == null]


func _material_ref(id: int) -> WeakRef:
	return weakref((instance_from_id(id).get_node("Sprite") as Sprite2D).material)


# --- checks ----------------------------------------------------------------

func _test_shader_uniforms() -> void:
	var list := (load(SHADER_PATH) as Shader).get_shader_uniform_list()
	var by_name := {}
	for u: Dictionary in list:
		by_name[u.name] = u
	_check("shader reports exactly two uniforms, no sampler", list.size() == 2, str(list))
	var m: Dictionary = by_name.get("burn_mix", {})
	var range_ok := false
	if m.get("hint") == PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE:
		var r := String(m.get("hint_string", "")).split(",")
		range_ok = r.size() >= 2 and float(r[0]) == 0.0 and float(r[1]) == 1.0
	_check("burn_mix is a float with hint_range(0, 1)", m.get("type") == TYPE_FLOAT and range_ok, str(m))
	var c: Dictionary = by_name.get("burn_color", {})
	_check("burn_color is a Color", c.get("type") == TYPE_COLOR, str(c))


## Defaults are not reported headlessly, so they are read from the source text (whitespace collapsed).
func _test_shader_source() -> void:
	var src := RegEx.create_from_string("\\s+").sub(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH), " ", true)
	_check("source: burn_mix defaults to 0.0",
			src.contains("uniform float burn_mix : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0;"))
	_check("source: burn_color is source_color, default (1.0, 0.752941, 0.125490, 1.0)",
			src.contains("uniform vec4 burn_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.752941, 0.125490, 1.0);"))
	_check("source: the colour line is COLOR.rgb = mix(COLOR.rgb, burn_color.rgb, burn_mix);",
			src.contains("COLOR.rgb = mix(COLOR.rgb, burn_color.rgb, burn_mix);"))
	_check("source: no render_mode, no sampler, no TIME",
			not src.contains("render_mode") and not src.contains("sampler2D") and not src.contains("TIME"))


## Rule 6: three scarecrows, an arrow for the middle one only.
func _test_instances_independent() -> void:
	await _fresh(1.0)
	var ids := await _spawn_watched([Vector2(300, 423), TARGET, Vector2(1240, 423)])
	var mats: Array[int] = []
	var shaders: Array[int] = []
	var setup_ok := true
	var color_unset := true
	for id in ids:
		var info := _material_info(id)
		setup_ok = setup_ok and info[2]
		color_unset = color_unset and info[3]
		mats.append(info[0])
		shaders.append(info[1])
	_check("each Sprite has a ShaderMaterial using %s" % SHADER_PATH, setup_ok)
	if not setup_ok:
		return
	_check("the three scarecrows have three distinct ShaderMaterials",
			mats[0] != mats[1] and mats[1] != mats[2] and mats[0] != mats[2], str(mats))
	_check("all three share the one Shader; burn_color is unset (shader default) on each",
			shaders[0] == shaders[1] and shaders[1] == shaders[2] and color_unset)

	var fired0: int = rec.fired
	var k0 := sampler.size()
	var k_hit := await _arrow_hit(1)
	var k_end := await _await_zero(1, k_hit + 1) if k_hit > 0 else -1
	_check("[3 scarecrows] exactly one auto-fired arrow ignites the middle one",
			k_hit > 0 and k_end > 0 and rec.fired - fired0 == 1,
			"hit at %d, end at %d, arrows %d" % [k_hit, k_end, rec.fired - fired0])
	if k_hit < 0 or k_end < 0:
		return
	_check("[3 scarecrows] at the hit: (%.4f, %.4f, %.4f), expected (0, 0.65, 0)" % [
			sampler.mix[0][k_hit], sampler.mix[1][k_hit], sampler.mix[2][k_hit]],
			sampler.mix[0][k_hit] == 0.0 and _peak_ok(1, k_hit) and sampler.mix[2][k_hit] == 0.0)
	var k2 := k_hit
	while k2 < k_end and sampler.btl[1][k2] > 2.0:
		k2 += 1
	_check("[3 scarecrows] with %.4f s left: (%.4f, %.4f, %.4f), expected (0, ~0.325, 0)" % [
			sampler.btl[1][k2], sampler.mix[0][k2], sampler.mix[1][k2], sampler.mix[2][k2]],
			sampler.mix[0][k2] == 0.0 and absf(sampler.mix[1][k2] - 0.325) <= PEAK * sampler.dt[k2] / DURATION + EPS
			and sampler.mix[2][k2] == 0.0)
	_check("[3 scarecrows] the outer two read 0.0 in all %d frames of the middle one's burn" % (k_end - k0),
			_all_equal(0, 0, k_end + 1, 0.0) and _all_equal(2, 0, k_end + 1, 0.0))


## Rules 1, 2 and 4: one arrow, at the given Engine.time_scale.
func _test_single_burn(scale: float) -> void:
	await _fresh(scale)
	var ids := await _spawn_watched([TARGET])
	var s := instance_from_id(ids[0]) as Scarecrow
	var r := {"ended_k": -1, "started": 0}
	s.burning_ended.connect(func() -> void: r.ended_k = sampler.size())
	s.burning_started.connect(func() -> void: r.started += 1)
	s = null
	var label := "time_scale %.1f" % scale
	var fired0: int = rec.fired
	var k_hit := await _arrow_hit(0)
	var k_end := await _await_zero(0, k_hit + 1) if k_hit > 0 else -1
	_check("[%s] one auto-fired arrow ignites it" % label,
			k_hit > 0 and k_end > 0 and r.started == 1 and rec.fired - fired0 == 1,
			"hit at %d, end at %d, started %d, arrows %d" % [k_hit, k_end, r.started, rec.fired - fired0])
	if k_hit < 0 or k_end < 0:
		return
	var fps := _fps(k_hit)
	var period := sampler.frame_dt[k_hit]
	_check("[%s] burn_mix is 0.0 in every frame before the hit" % label, _all_equal(0, 0, k_hit, 0.0))
	_check("[%s] first frame after the hit: %.6f (%d ticks in it), Rule 1 / revision A" % [
			label, sampler.mix[0][k_hit], sampler.nticks[k_hit]], _peak_ok(0, k_hit))
	_check("[%s] burn_mix is 0.0 in the frame burning_ended is emitted, > 0 the frame before" % label,
			r.ended_k == k_end and sampler.mix[0][k_end] == 0.0 and sampler.mix[0][k_end - 1] > 0.0,
			"ended at %d, zero at %d" % [r.ended_k, k_end])
	var ticks := 0
	for k in range(k_hit + 1, k_end + 1):
		ticks += sampler.nticks[k]
	print("INFO [%s @ %d fps] %d physics ticks from hit to 0.0 (%d = 4 s); burn_time_left the frame before: %s" % [
			label, fps, ticks, roundi(DURATION * 60.0 / scale), String.num_scientific(sampler.btl[0][k_end - 1])])
	var game_time := sampler.t[k_end] - sampler.t[k_hit]
	_check("[%s @ %d fps] 0.65 -> 0.0 takes %.6f s of game time, 4.0 +- one frame (%.6f)" % [
			label, fps, game_time, period], absf(game_time - DURATION) <= period + EPS)
	var real_time := float(k_end - k_hit) / fps
	_check("[%s @ %d fps] that is %d frames = %.4f s real time, 4.0/%.1f = %.4f +- one frame" % [
			label, fps, k_end - k_hit, real_time, scale, DURATION / scale],
			absf(real_time - DURATION / scale) <= 1.0 / fps + EPS)
	await process_frame
	_check("[%s] no further arrow after the burn" % label, rec.fired - fired0 == 1, "arrows %d" % (rec.fired - fired0))


## Rule 4: a real P mid-burn freezes burn_time_left and burn_mix; P again continues from there.
func _test_pause_freezes() -> void:
	await _fresh(1.0)
	var ids := await _spawn_watched([TARGET])
	var s := instance_from_id(ids[0]) as Scarecrow
	var r := {"ended_k": -1}
	s.burning_ended.connect(func() -> void: r.ended_k = sampler.size())
	s = null
	var fired0: int = rec.fired
	var k_hit := await _arrow_hit(0)
	_check("[pause] one auto-fired arrow ignites it", k_hit > 0 and rec.fired - fired0 == 1,
			"arrows %d" % (rec.fired - fired0))
	if k_hit < 0:
		return
	while sampler.t[sampler.size() - 1] - sampler.t[k_hit] < 1.5:
		await process_frame
	await physics_frame            # the game flushes input before the frame's physics
	_key(KEY_P, true)
	_key(KEY_P, false)
	var k_p := sampler.size()
	var was_paused := paused
	for n in 30:
		await process_frame
	await physics_frame
	_key(KEY_P, true)
	_key(KEY_P, false)
	var k_r := sampler.size()
	var resumed := not paused
	for n in 12:                   # samples land at the end of a frame: k_r + 9 exists after 11
		await process_frame
	var frozen_mix := sampler.mix[0][k_p - 1]
	var frozen_left := sampler.btl[0][k_p - 1]
	var frozen := frozen_mix > 0.0
	for k in range(k_p, k_r):
		frozen = frozen and sampler.paused[k] == 1 and sampler.mix[0][k] == frozen_mix \
				and sampler.btl[0][k] == frozen_left
	_check("[pause] P pauses and P resumes", was_paused and resumed)
	_check("[pause] burn_mix %.6f and burn_time_left %.6f identical over %d paused frames" % [
			frozen_mix, frozen_left, k_r - k_p], frozen and k_r - k_p >= 30)
	var first := sampler.btl[0][k_r]
	_check("[pause] after resume it continues from the frozen value (%.6f -> %.6f -> %.6f)" % [
			frozen_left, first, sampler.btl[0][k_r + 9]],
			first <= frozen_left and first >= frozen_left - sampler.dt[k_r] - EPS
			and sampler.btl[0][k_r + 9] < frozen_left)

	var game_time := sampler.t[k_end] - sampler.t[k_hit] if k_end > 0 else -1.0
	_check("[pause] the paused burn still takes %.6f s of game time, 4.0 +- one frame" % game_time,
			k_end > 0 and r.ended_k == k_end and absf(game_time - DURATION) <= sampler.frame_dt[k_hit] + EPS)


## Rules 3 and 5: a second real arrow once burn_mix < 0.3, then the scarecrow burns to death.
func _test_retrigger_then_death() -> void:
	await _fresh(1.0)
	var ids := await _spawn_watched([RETRIGGER_TARGET])
	var id := ids[0]
	var s := instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow
	var sprite_id := s.get_node("Sprite").get_instance_id()
	var mat_ref := _material_ref(id)
	var r := {"died_k": -1, "died_left": -1.0}
	s.died.connect(func() -> void:
		r.died_k = sampler.size()
		r.died_left = (instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow).burn_time_left)
	s = null
	var fired0: int = rec.fired
	var k1 := await _arrow_hit(0)
	_check("[retrigger] first auto-fired arrow ignites it", k1 > 0 and rec.fired - fired0 == 1,
			"arrows %d" % (rec.fired - fired0))
	if k1 < 0:
		return
	while sampler.mix[0][sampler.size() - 1] >= 0.3:
		await process_frame
	var k2 := await _arrow_hit(0)
	_check("[retrigger] a second auto-fired arrow hits it", k2 > 0 and rec.fired - fired0 == 2,
			"arrows %d" % (rec.fired - fired0))
	if k2 < 0:
		return
	_check("[retrigger] burn_mix %.6f (< 0.3) returns to %.6f in the hit frame (%d ticks), Rule 3" % [
			sampler.mix[0][k2 - 1], sampler.mix[0][k2], sampler.nticks[k2]],
			sampler.mix[0][k2 - 1] < 0.3 and _peak_ok(0, k2))
	var n := 0
	while r.died_k < 0 and n < MAX_FRAMES:
		await process_frame
		n += 1
	_check("[death] it burns to death while still burning (%.4f s left)" % r.died_left,
			r.died_k > 0 and r.died_left > 0.0)
	if r.died_k < 0:
		return
	await process_frame
	_check("[death] the next frame the scarecrow and its Sprite are freed",
			not is_instance_id_valid(id) and not is_instance_id_valid(sprite_id))
	_check("[death] its ShaderMaterial is freed too (weakref is null): nothing keeps the tint",
			mat_ref.get_ref() == null)
	await process_frame
	_check("[death] the sampler finds nothing to read after the death frame",
			sampler.mix[0][r.died_k + 1] == GONE)
	_check("[retrigger] exactly two arrows in this case", rec.fired - fired0 == 2,
			"arrows %d" % (rec.fired - fired0))
